title: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sents.t: The following footage was posted by Vanessa Berlin, who had caught something disturbing on her doorbell camera.
sents.zh: 下面这段视频是 Vanessa Berlin 发布的，她的门铃摄像头拍到了一些让人不安的东西。

sents.t: Vanessa writes, "I grew up in a haunted home with paranormal investigators and priests constantly coming to my house, so I don't get that scared easily.
sents.zh: Vanessa 写道：“我是在一栋闹鬼的房子里长大的，灵异调查员和神父总来我家，所以我没那么容易被吓到。

sents.t: But last night, I saw this through my Ring camera at 11:30 PM, and it was the only time that I truly felt scared."
sents.zh: 但昨晚 11 点半，我在 Ring 门铃摄像头里看到了这个，那是我唯一一次真正感到害怕。”

sents.t: Be sure to look closely, or you'll miss it.
sents.zh: 一定要仔细看，不然就错过了。

sents.t: A faint image of what appears to be a face can be seen hiding behind the flowers.
sents.zh: 花丛后面隐约能看到一个像是人脸的影像。

sents.t: It's hard to make out what this is, but it seems like someone, or something, is looking at the doorbell camera.
sents.zh: 很难看清这是什么，但似乎有人——或者某种东西——正盯着门铃摄像头。

sents.t: But as always, I'll let you decide as to what this might be.
sents.zh: 不过和往常一样，这到底是什么，由你来判断。

sents.t: What exactly is being seen on camera?
sents.zh: 镜头里拍到的究竟是什么？
